options.name: action
options.description: Specifies which operation needs to be performed. C(initialize) initializes master key for data encryption; C(unlock) authenticates to unlock master key of the device; C(add) adds additional authentication methods; C(check) checks validity of an authentication method; C(delete) removes an authentication method;

options.name: auth_detail
options.description: Specifies any additional information about the key-protection method In case of keyfile authentication method, input path to the authentication key file needs to be provided.

options.name: auth_index
options.description: Specifies the index of the authentication method upon which C(action) needs to be performed.

options.name: auth_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the authentication method.

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Specifies the type of authentication method you want to perform the C(action) upon. C(pwd) specifies passphrase authentication method. C(keyfile) specifies key file based authentication method. C(pks) specifies PKS based authentication method.

options.name: auto_key_protection
options.description: Authenticates to the encrypted LV by using the automatic key-protection methods that do not require any user inputs.

options.name: device
options.description: Specifies the device for which you want to manage the authentication methods.

options.name: force
options.description: Specifies if -f flag should be used with the command to forcefully perform the action.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password in case when C(auth_type) is set to pwd.
